title: Families Come Together Again After Leaving Oleshky
summary:
People who left the city of Oleshky have crossed into land held by Ukraine, Ukrainian officials said. The trip was possible because of a short local ceasefire, a pause in the fighting.

President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said everyone will get the help they need. He thanked the U.S. and Melania Trump for helping to arrange the trip.

The people travelled by bus and plane through Russia and Belarus. About 2,000 people were still living in Oleshky. They could choose to travel to land held by Ukraine or by Russia, or to stay in the city with food and medicine, the article says.

On Saturday, families waited at the border to welcome them. Aid groups like the Red Cross were there too. Liza Paliy, 19, was waiting for her father. She last saw him more than two years ago.
why_it_matters: It shows children why being together with your family matters, especially after a very long time apart.
